source_evidence.claim_boundary: Scripted offline wiring evidence; not live-model, clinical-quality, real-latency, or real-cost evidence.

rationale: The bounded full agent improves both held-out task success and tool-required success over both named baselines.
The scripted safety rates do not regress and no high-severity safety failure or budget violation is observed.
The extra tool work and estimated token and latency overhead are visible and remain inside the existing per-request limits.

missing_evidence: selected model artifact and measured local resource budget
held-out task-specific IoU and measurement-error report
approval_gates: Approve one synthetic, de-identified, or license-cleared mask dataset and one redistributable model artifact.
Pre-register task-specific IoU, measurement-error, latency, memory, and safety thresholds.
Fit the capability inside the three-tool limit by replacement, or separately approve a revised tool budget.
Prove every output remains a visual locator and still passes deterministic response and provenance verification.
safety_constraints: No diagnosis, triage, treatment, or clinical-report authority.
A mask cannot bypass abstention, confidence, provenance, or response-schema checks.
No real patient image or PHI may enter the default fixture or evaluation path.

missing_evidence: pre-registered residual failures not caught by deterministic verification
actor-only versus actor-plus-critic ablation on identical cases
measured live latency, token, and cost overhead
approval_gates: Identify a reproducible residual-failure set where deterministic verification is insufficient.
Show a positive task or safety improvement on that set without a regression on the frozen benchmark.
Measure added latency, token use, cost, and new failure modes before changing the topology.
Keep the critic read-only with no tool, permission, or external-action authority.
safety_constraints: The critic cannot grant permissions or override deterministic guards.
The critic cannot call tools or create external side effects.
Actor and critic outputs remain inside the same non-diagnostic response contract.

missing_evidence: approved access to an exact benchmark version
verified data, code, and result-reporting licenses
approval_gates: Select and approve one exact benchmark version before downloading or executing it.
Review license, data provenance, PHI, network, and side-effect boundaries.
Map only compatible tasks and actions; do not reinterpret clinical actions as local evidence tasks.
Run in a separate sandbox and label external results separately from CXR-AgentBench-v0.
safety_constraints: No EHR, PACS, patient-system, or clinical-action integration is authorized.
External scores cannot be merged with or substituted for the owned benchmark metrics.
Incompatible tasks must be excluded and reported, not silently adapted.
